<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/showcase.ts -->
<!--
  Video testimonials as thumbnails: a picture, a play button, the name and the company. The player is a port
  contract (VideoEmbed); here the button emits `play`. Axes: columns (2, 3), caption (below, overlay), tone,
  density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Quote } from "./testimonial-grid.types";

  export type VideoGridProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    quotes: Quote[];
    playLabel: string;
    byLine: string;
    cols?: "1-2" | "1-3";
    caption?: "below" | "overlay";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    onplay?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import FigureBlock from "../components/figure-block.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    quotes,
    playLabel,
    byLine,
    cols = "1-3",
    caption = "below",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    onplay,
  }: VideoGridProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Grid cols={cols} class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
    {#each quotes as q (q.id)}
      <FigureBlock class="m-0 flex flex-col gap-4" testid="item">
        <Box class="relative">
          <MediaFrame alt={q.author} />
          <Button
            variant="default"
            size="default"
            type="button"
            class="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 size-12 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded p-0"
            aria-label={tpl(playLabel, q.author)}
            data-testid="play"
            onclick={() => onplay?.(q.id)}
          >
            <LucideIcon name="play" size={20} />
          </Button>
          {#if ((caption as string) === "overlay")}
            <Box class="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 rounded bg-background p-4" data-testid="caption">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {q.author}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {tpl(byLine, q.role, q.company)}
              </Text>
            </Box>
          {/if}
        </Box>
        {#if ((caption as string) === "below")}
          <Text tag="figcaption" data-testid="caption">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {q.author}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {tpl(byLine, q.role, q.company)}
            </Text>
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </FigureBlock>
    {/each}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
